observation: Builder src/render/opticCellPresentation.js. Stone variant 3 reuses ast:geology-v5:ast_common_rock:3 (visualFactory.js:2259-2261; opticCellGeometry returns null at 122-126 so the shared common-rock buffer is chosen) and the cached 'optic:body:stone:v3' material (132-160, 248-256). ROCK_SURFACE_VARIANTS[3] is the fresh-fracture row (tint [0.84,0.82,0.78], roughness 0.85, ao 0.70, normalScale 0.82; rockSurfaceLibrary.js:24) — the brightest, least rough stone, still an absorber because metalness resolves from the ORM lane and emissive is zero (146-157). Deliberate preserved role: all five stone variants stay matte rock, never mirror or prism (module header 6-20; test/optic-materials.test.mjs:85-89). No per-cell geometry or material allocation; pairs are cached by key and pool-warmed (396-407).
decision: No construction change recommended; the variant is an intended surface response on shared geometry. Recommend needs follow-up because visual acceptance is outstanding.
next: Needs a current capture comparing variant 3's fresh-fracture response with variants 0-2 and 4 at gameplay scale, plus draw cost.
